tokens.name: page-bg
tokens.usage: Page ground, as rendered behind the page's content. Every text pairing below is checked against it.

tokens.name: page-text
tokens.usage: Default body text on `page-bg`: the colour most of the page's text uses that reads on it (13.2:1).

tokens.name: page-surface
tokens.usage: Surface most of the page's running text sits on (cards, panels).

tokens.name: color-deep-black
tokens.usage: Foundation, premium sophistication. Used as background on `body`.

tokens.name: color-dark-surface
tokens.usage: Elevated cards, glass layers. Used as background on `.stat-card`, `.content-card`, `.table-container`.

tokens.name: color-electric-purple
tokens.usage: Innovation, blockchain technology. Used as background on `body::before`, `.btn-outline:hover`, `.stat-icon.purple`; shadow/glow on `.content-card:hover`; border on `.metric`.

tokens.name: color-purple-glow
tokens.usage: Innovation, blockchain technology. Used as shadow/glow on `.btn-outline:hover`, `.btn-icon:hover`, `.social-link:hover`.

tokens.name: color-purple-border
tokens.usage: Innovation, blockchain technology. Used as background on `body::before`, `.btn-outline:hover`, `.stat-icon.purple`; shadow/glow on `.content-card:hover`; border on `.metric`.

tokens.name: color-gold
tokens.usage: Wealth, premium value, institutional trust. Used as text on `.gold-text`, `.stat-icon.gold`, `.badge.gold`. 11.7:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-gold-accent
tokens.usage: Wealth, premium value, institutional trust. 1.7:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-platinum
tokens.usage: Refinement, secondary information. Used as text on `.nav-link`, `.page-subtitle`, `.stat-label`. 7.6:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-success-glow
tokens.usage: Success state; pair with a label or icon.

tokens.name: btn-premium-bg
tokens.usage: Painted directly by the reference page: background on `.btn-premium::before`, `.category-tag`; border on `.category-tag`; text on `.category-tag`. 19.6:1 on `page-bg`.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero and page titles — as `h1.page-title` on the reference page.

styles.name: heading-2
styles.usage: Section headings — as `h2.section-title` on the reference page.

styles.name: heading-3
styles.usage: Card and module titles — as `h3.card-title` on the reference page.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Body copy — as `td` on the reference page.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Labels, eyebrows and table headers, set in uppercase — as `span.stat-label` on the reference page.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button labels — as `button.btn-outline` on the reference page.

tokens.name: radius-medium
tokens.usage: Used as border on `.data-table th:first-child`, `.data-table th:last-child`.
